public_feature_inputs: Only the five public board cards and both complete ordered declared ranges. Alternative own hands are NOT filtered by actual own private cards; no actual hidden opponent hand is an input.
joint_compatibility: An ordered seat0-by-seat1 Boolean matrix; true iff both hypothetical two-card hands and public board are physically disjoint. Joint equals both public availability masks times the fixed private-card-disjointness matrix.
grouping: Refine the SAME full-static source groups successively with responding-seat public availability, both seats' public availability, both masks plus joint matrix, and exact own-information singletons. Group by feature VALUES, never board lookup hashes or row IDs except in the exact-information control.
frozen_values: Reuse every checked PR52 actual/prior conditional action value and both frozen own suffixes. No new Q optimization, posterior estimation, strategy intervention or hand subset.
weighting: Retain every original river row, including zero actual support. For all five controls, use the SAME positive-source-support rows and original pre-filter-normalized uniform decision weights. Never renormalize after filtering.
numerical_controls: Independent scalar fsum local-cost reconstruction matches every original static group/aggregate within fixed tolerance. Refinement cannot increase convex cost. Both-public and both-public-plus-joint partitions must match exactly as member sets with fixed ranges. Singleton costs/conflicts zero; unchanged features keep groups unchanged. No positive-effect success gate.
interpretation: Grouping association under fixed saved continuations, not causal policy attribution, game EV, exploitability, retraining gain or acceptance of an agent feature. Group/conflict denominators differ; known games and dependent repeated records are not independent samples.
display_order: Original actual-posterior full-static local cost descending then source group ID; display only. All rows/groups/panels retained.
clock_scope: Thin entry before numerical imports through complete cached-parent validation, features, regrouping and writes; interpreter startup excluded. Not original full-game mathematical replay or new trajectories.
failures: Refuse existing destinations. Retain each completed profile and partial/failure metadata before advancing; keep unfavorable and incomplete outcomes.
